instruction.text: Which picture matches the metaphor in the sentence?

hint.label: Metaphor
hint.text:
A metaphor describes one thing as another one without using the words like or as.

For example:
Life is a roller coaster.
hint.sound: ssml: A metaphor describes one thing as another one without using the words like or as. For example: Life is a roller coaster.

atoms.a: A baby’s laughter is music to my ears.

instruction.text: What does the metaphor in the sentence mean?

b: Her brother is a kind and sweet boy.
Her brother turns into a monster at midnight.
Ben loves eating potatoes on the sofa.
++Ben spends a lot of time relaxing.
Ben likes hiding potatoes under the sofa.
Kelly likes to sleep at night.
++Kelly likes to be active at night.

atoms.a: A baby’s laughter is music to my ears.
b: A baby’s laughter sounds horrible to me.
A baby’s laughter sounds like a catchy pop song.
++A baby’s laughter sounds pleasant to me.

instruction.text: Match the figures of speech with their definitions.

atoms.a: This figure of speech compares two things with one another. It is usually used with the words like or as.
